MAZDA3 2.0 SEDAN
AVAILABLE EXTERIOR COLORS1
KEY FEATURES INCLUDE:
SKYACTIV®-G 2.0 DOHC 16-valve, 4-cylinder engine 8-speaker audio system Dual front air bags, front side-impact air bags and
SKYACTIV-Drive 6-speed automatic with manual shift Bluetooth® hands-free phone and audio streaming side-impact air curtain6
and Sport modes USB audio input ports (2) Driver’s and front passenger’s knee air bag6
SKYACTIV-VEHICLE DYNAMICS with G-Vectoring Steering-wheel-mounted audio and cruise controls Dynamic Stability Control7 and Traction Control System
Control Plus MAZDA CONNECT™ Infotainment System3 with: Rear View Monitor8
16-inch alloy wheels with P205/60 R16 tires 8.8-inch full-color display, Multifunction Commander Tire Pressure Monitoring System
Body-colored dual folding power side mirrors control, Infotainment system voice command, LATCH child-seat anchors and upper tethers
LED headlights with auto on/off, combination taillights HD Radio,™ Pandora® integration, Radio Broadcast Smart Brake Support10
and daytime running lights Data System program information, SMS text message Driver Attention Alert11
Rain-sensing windshield wipers audio delivery and reply and Mobile 911 automatic Mazda Radar Cruise Control with Stop & Go12
Air conditioning emergency notification19 Lane Departure Warning System13
Cloth-trimmed seats with seatback pocket Mazda Connected Services (3-year trial)4 Lane-keep Assist13
Power windows with one-touch up/down feature 60/40 split fold-down rear seatback High Beam Control
Power door locks with remote keyless entry system Driver’s and front passenger’s sun visors with extension
7-inch LCD meter display and vanity mirror
(Continued from previous page) Be aware of the traffic around you. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see Owner's Manual for further details. 10 Smart Brake Support operates under certain conditions between
about 6.2 and 50 mph when the object is a pedestrian or bicycle and 2 mph or higher when the object is a vehicle. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving and is only designed to reduce damage in the event of a collision. There are
limitations to the operation and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 11 Driver Attention Alert operates between about 41 and 86 mph. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations
to the operation and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 12 Mazda Radar Cruise Control (MRCC) with Stop & Go is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection
of the system. Driver action is required to resume MRCC with Stop & Go after a complete stop. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 13 Lane Departure Warning System and Lane-keep Assist operate at speeds of about 40 mph and faster.
Neither system is a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of each system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 14 Always check your mirrors. Be aware of your surroundings. There are
limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 15 360º View Monitor may not provide a comprehensive view of the entire surrounding area of this vehicle. Always check your surroundings visually.
Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 16 Traffic Jam Assist is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 17 Smart Brake
Support–Rear operates under certain conditions between about 2 and 4 mph when an obstruction is detected at the rear of the vehicle. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving and is only designed to reduce damage in the event of a collision.
There are limitations to the operation and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 18 Smart Brake Support–Rear Crossing operates under certain conditions when a vehicle approaches from the rear left or rear right
while you reverse out of a parking space. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving and is only designed to reduce damage in the event of a collision. There are limitations to the operation and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual
for further details. 19 Mobile 911 automatically calls 911 from a paired hands-free device when a moderate to severe collision is detected. Specific phone settings are required. There are limitations to the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for
further details. PRODUCT CHANGES AND OPTIONS AVAILABILITY: Following publication of this brochure, certain changes in standard equipment, options, prices and the like—or product delays—may have occurred which would not be included in
these pages. Your Mazda Dealer is your best source for up-to-date information. Mazda reserves the right to change product specifications at any time without incurring obligations.
